: "Opening
1. Peak Palosseum opens every Monday at 01:00 server time and ends on Sunday at 24:00.
Participating
1. Each season runs three tiers simultaneously: Advanced (includes 1-4 divisions), Intermediate (1-2 divisions), and Novice (your own division only).
2. Advanced tier: Top 200 in your division. Intermediate tier: Ranked 201-800. Novice tier: Ranked 801+. During the season, if you rank up to 201-800 in Novice, a promotion prompt will appear. If you rank in the Top 200 in Intermediate, a promotion prompt will appear for Advanced. Promotion eligibility is retained for the current season.
Competition phase
1. Palosseum initial ranking is based on your squad's Power.
2. Palosseum initial points: 1,000.
3. Tap Challenge to see 5 nearby opponents. Choose one to battle. The winner gains points, and the loser loses points. The greater the point difference, the more points are gained or lost.
4. Each explorer has a limited number of daily challenge attempts per season.
Rewards
1. Reach 1, 3, or 5 daily Challenges to claim daily chests.
2. At the end of the Palosseum season, personal and guild rewards are distributed based on final rankings.
3. Personal and guild rewards are sent via PMail.
Lineup
1. Your highest-Power squad is set as the defensive lineup by default.
2. Palosseum battles don't consume Armigo. Your highest-level Armigo are used by default."

: "1. Apex Showdown is a cross-server event with three stages: Signup (3 days), Qualifiers (3 days), and Knockouts (1 day).
2. Signup Stage. Choose one of the 3 available continental divisions:
   - Europe Division: Matches begin daily at 00:00 (UTC-2).
   - Asia Division: Matches begin daily at 08:00 (UTC-2).
   - Americas Division: Matches begin daily at 16:00 (UTC-2).
Players will only be matched against other players in the same division. Each division will have its own rankings and crown its own Apex Champions.
3. You must create 3 unique Palmon squads to signup (Palmon cannot be repeated across squads). During each match, your 3 squads will sequentially battle against your opponent's 3 squads. The first player to win 2 battles wins the match.
4. Qualifiers Stage. Lasts 3 days with 5 matchups per day. Each matchup includes 1-min matchmaking, 10-min squad lineup adjustment, and 1-min pre-battle wait.
5. During the Qualifiers, you can claim rewards based on your total win count.
6. Knockouts Stage.
    6.1. The Top 64 players from each division's Qualifiers (ranked by wins) will advance to the Knockouts. Player Power Rankings will be used as a tiebreaker.
    6.2. The Top 64 players are divided into 8 groups of 8. Players face off in head-to-head elimination matches until each group has a single winner.
    6.3. The 8 group winners compete in further head-to-head elimination matches until one Apex Champion emerges.
    6.4. Each head-to-head matchup is a best-of-3 rounds competition. Each round consists of up to 3 squad battles; winning 2 squad battles wins the round. The first player to win 2 rounds advances.
    6.5. Rewards are distributed based on your final placement in the rankings. All divisions offer the same ranking rewards.
7. Basic groups don't offer Reputation as rewards. Reputation rewards are available in advanced groups." -> "1. Apex Showdown is a cross-server event with three stages: Signup (3 days), Qualifiers (3 days), and Knockouts (1 day).

4. Qualifiers Stage. Lasts 3 days with 5 matchups per day. Each matchup includes 1-min matchmaking, 10-min squad lineup adjustment, and 2-min pre-battle wait.
5. During the Qualifiers, you can claim rewards based on your total win count.
6. Knockouts Stage.

: "Ahoy, explorer!
Check out all the cool new changes in this update!

Notable Updates:
1. The Bloomstone and Titan Seal rewards from the Rotation Conquest Season's "Realm Rewards" have been changed to choice chests. Different tiers now only differ in amount, not type. You can choose what you need.
2. Conquest Season new Mythic Palmon: Dialuna (Earth), is now available via Aurora Summons.
- Dialuna is a Conquest Season exclusive Mythic Palmon. By ascending, upgrading, and evolving, you can unlock special effects such as: increasing Desert building level caps, raising the claimable plots limit, boosting Camel transport load capacity, and directly earning Tech Points.
3. Migration identity distribution has been adjusted. The requirements for Pathfinder (Rare) have been increased, so more migrants will be classified as Drifter (Common). This change will take effect in the next event for currently open servers.
4. All VIP Bundles will be reset in the next update. Explorers can purchase their favorite bundles again.
5. For S1 Server Showdown and S2 Faction Showdown, guilds must have a total of 5,000,000 points to be eligible for ranking rewards (Ember and Sacred Relics) based on total guild points.

General Improvements & Fixes:
1. Fixed an issue where some Sanctums could not be declared war on during the Rotation Season.
2. Fixed an issue where disbanded guilds still appeared on the Rift Battlefield Qualifier leaderboard.
3. Fixed an issue where tapping an unowned Palmon's avatar showed incorrect unlock conditions.
4. Fixed an issue where recovered cargo still appeared in Airship raid battle reports.
5. Fixed an issue with chat channel delays.
6. Fixed an issue where sharing Coordinates across servers was not working properly.
7. Fixed an issue with abnormal World Channel display.
8. Fixed an issue with Desert Tech unlock order.
9. Fixed an issue where S1 Temperature values and S2 Curse Level values were abnormal in some cases.
10. Fixed an issue where squad HP bars did not update in real time during reinforcement in Desert Wonderland.
11. Fixed an issue where squad HP bars did not update in real time during reinforcement in Sandstorm Scuffle.

Palmon: Survival Team" -> "Ahoy, explorer!

Check out all the cool new changes in this update!

Key Adjustments:
1. New Power Details Feature
- Unlocks at Camp Lvl 6.
- The Power pop-up on the main screen now shows Power sources, helping explorers understand how each upgrade contributes to their Power.
- Added upgrade recommendations and ratings that automatically identify weak spots, along with Camp progress and comparisons with active players on the same Pallantis.
- Power ratings range from C to SSS (C, B, A, S, SS, SSS). If your rating is below S, the "Power Up" button will lead you to the upgrade recommendations section.
2. Desert Tech Improvements
- Added display for Tech Point usage and remaining points.
- Added a red dot notification for unused Tech Points.
- Added a public Desert Tech build library where explorers can view and reference other players' Tech builds.
3. Palosseum Improvements
- Palosseum battles now include Armigo, and Armigo levels are displayed following the same rules as Peak Palosseum.
- Improved Power display during opponent selection and battle results. The UI now consistently shows true squad Power, and opponent Power is based on their defense lineup.
- Added a Battle Report button to the battle results screen, allowing you to view detailed reports that include Armigo.
- Added a Battle Report entry and battle replay feature. Squad Power for the battle is now shown in the report details.
- Fixed an issue where the win reward countdown displayed incorrectly. The countdown now matches the event schedule.
4. Added Conqueror victory rewards for Pyramid Onslaught. The winning Conqueror Pallantis will receive an exclusive Emblem.
5. Adjusted Armigo morale growth ratios of Lvl 5, 6 and 7, improving early Armigo Hut upgrade feedback to make all upgrade paths more balanced.
6. Equipment Reset Improvements: Removed the reset limit. Each reset now costs 500 Pallite.
7. Apex Showdown Improvements: After the champion is decided, you can view battle reports for all Top 64 teams and each group.
8. Skill enhancements for Shadowvolt, the Mega Evolved form of Abuzzinian:
Stormcall: When battle begins, summon a thundercloud. After 15s, it strikes all enemies. Every 10s after that, deals 480% damage per strike. Boosts all allied Electric Palmon's damage reduction by 20%. (Does not stack with Fulgairy's Thunderous Boon damage reduction.)
Enhancement: Damage dealt per stike (except the first) increased from 150% to 480%.
Thunder Hunt: Each Stormcall lightning strike has a 60% chance to become a Super Strike. Deals 800% damage. In battle, boosts all allied Electric Palmon's Stun Resist by 20% and Freeze Resist by 20%.
Enhancement: Super Strike chance increased from 50% to 60%, and Super Strike damage increased from 300% to 800%.
9. Added a message block feature to Migration channels.

General Improvements & Fixes:
1. Added a report option to server megaphone messages, allowing you to report chat content directly.
2. Added a help request prompt to the building button on the left after upgrading.
3. Improved Battle Report display: Some report modules will unlock gradually based on server age to reduce information clutter for new servers.
4. Improved Hoofrit Rampage battle trigger logic to reduce lag from multiple simultaneous battles, improving overall combat performance.
5. Dream Isle Improvements: Buildings that cannot be upgraded will no longer display a level indicator.
6. Improved the visual and text presentation of Class Skills.
7. Improved the performance and visuals of the Boss capture screen.
8. Improved the pop-up display after building upgrades.
9. Fixed an issue where Sanctum Chest claim attempts did not refresh after the daily reset until you relogged.
10. Fixed issues where private chat red dots could not be cleared after migration and where the chat list scrolling was abnormal.
11. Fixed an issue where the rally name for Regalion Pride displayed incorrectly.
12. Fixed an issue where nearby resource nodes were not recognized correctly in some scenarios.
13. Improved Abuzzinian's Mega Evolve name to better fit its character and design.
14. Updated the description of the Desert Tech skill Hourglass of Time to remove the incorrect "points reset" description.
